title: Burstcoin Mining Pool & Cloud Infrastructure
summary: Multi-tenant Proof-of-Capacity mining pool aggregating global hard-drive deadlines, running high-performance C++ plotters, and orchestrating automated proportional payouts on AWS/GCP dual-cloud infrastructure.
highlights: Multi-region AWS EC2 and GCP Compute Engine infrastructure delivering sub-25ms global miner latency and 99.99% uptime.
Automated Proof-of-Capacity deadline aggregation engine filtering lowest submitted disk nonces to forge blocks on-chain.
Proportional dividend payout engine distributing block rewards to hundreds of worldwide miners via automated RPC daemon scripts.
